results.name: idealDockIcon: 44–64 px band on the 4-px grid, from the screen not the app count; presets; junk input
planDock: keeps the pleasing size and folds the biggest groups first; pinned + running stay out; every app reachable; never wider than the fill limit when it reports fits
planDock on a phone: all groups fold, pinned apps fold back before shrinking, ≥32 px; with many minimised windows it reports !fits (dock scrolls)
desktop icons: column-major auto layout, saved cells win, contested/out-of-grid cells ignored, missing paths dropped (SH-04)
desktop icons: drag moves to a cell and swaps with an occupant, nudge clamps at the edges, clean up closes gaps in reading order, sort by name is natural
tabletop state: normalizeTable validates untrusted input against the files that exist
tabletop piles: drop card on card → pile at the target, drop on a pile adds on top, pile on pile merges, take out / dissolve, unstack, rename, deterministic ids
tabletop geometry: golden cards, jitter deterministic + bounded (top card straight), fan inside the floor, floor items never overlap their slots, hit test topmost
tabletop box geometry: floor scale = p/(p+depth) < 1, walls hinge on their screen edge and fold 90° inward
micro peek: Markdown keeps headings/bullets, plain text and code, line cap, CSV with RFC 4180 quoting, JSON grid / pretty text, images, SVG, binary, sealed, empty
beauty rules: each hard rule catches a seeded violation and passes the clean layout
open-with routing shared by Files / desktop / Tabletop; settings, routine 'view', seed rows
